epistemic_defect_in_adr_0154.identified_circularity: ADR-0154 equated z-computability (existence of deterministic R(x, D) -> z*) with oracle-equivalent supervision. In any formal deterministic task semantics, the target behavior/coordinate is mathematically computable from the input and task definition. Treating all computable specifications as oracle supervision renders non-oracle semantic specification impossible by tautology, creating an unfalsifiable circular criterion.
epistemic_defect_in_adr_0154.resolution: Establish a multi-dimensional oracle-supervision criterion independent of z-computability alone, pre-calibrated against positive and negative controls.

provenance.definition: Origin of the information signal: whether it originates from empirical ground-truth measurements, evaluator scoring, or teacher trajectories (Oracle), or from a priori formal grammatical definitions of the task language (Non-Oracle).

example_specificity.definition: Instance-dependence of the signal: whether the signal varies point-wise with each input sequence x or contains sequence-specific coordinate constants (Oracle), or is an x-invariant universal rule (Non-Oracle).

relation_specificity.definition: Generality and reusability of the signal: whether the signal is an ad-hoc coordinate patch tailored to a specific dataset/relation (Oracle), or a domain-general compositional operator across relations (Non-Oracle).

inference_time_availability.definition: Legitimacy of signal exposure during open-world testing: whether the signal relies on evaluator privilege/secret target tokens (Oracle), or is legitimately part of the visible task query/prompt at inference time (Non-Oracle).

counterfactual_invariance.definition: Robustness under input sequence perturbations: whether the signal breaks when sequence layout, key positions, or lengths change (Oracle), or dynamically preserves semantic meaning across counterfactual variations (Non-Oracle).

calibration_controls.name: pre_declared_semantic_rule
calibration_controls.description: Task/relation-wide pre-declared semantic operational rule in formal grammar (e.g. key matching predicate and offset).

calibration_controls.name: per_example_coordinate_label
calibration_controls.description: Explicit ground-truth target routing coordinate z*(x) supplied per sequence.

calibration_controls.name: relation_specific_lookup_map
calibration_controls.description: Hard-coded coordinate lookup map k -> z* or (x, k) -> z* tailored to relation.
